import argparse, hashlib, json, re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
for flag in ('snapshot', 'bundle-manifest', 'vitest', 'log', 'id', 'output', 'command'):
    parser.add_argument('--' + flag, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--exit-code', required=True, type=int)
args = parser.parse_args()
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
snapshot = Path(args.snapshot).resolve()
source = json.loads((snapshot / 'source-manifest.json').read_text())
bundle = json.loads(Path(args.bundle_manifest).read_text())
graph = Path(bundle['bundle']).parent
assert all(sha(graph / p) == h for p, h in bundle['files'].items()), 'Frozen module drift'
assert all(sha(snapshot / p) == h for p, h in source['filesSha256'].items()), 'Frozen source drift'
build_source = json.loads((Path(bundle['sourceRoot']) / 'source-manifest.json').read_text())['filesSha256']
runtime = lambda p: p.startswith(('server/', 'shared/')) or p in ('nitro.config.ts', 'package.json', 'bun.lock')
assert {p: h for p, h in source['filesSha256'].items() if runtime(p)} == {p: h for p, h in build_source.items() if runtime(p)}, 'Runtime source differs from build'
raw = json.loads(Path(args.vitest).read_text())
unhandled = re.search(r'Vitest caught (\d+) unhandled error', Path(args.log).read_text())
unhandled_count = int(unhandled.group(1)) if unhandled else 0
tests, statuses, identities = [], Counter(), set()
for suite in raw['testResults']:
    file = str(Path(suite['name']).resolve().relative_to(snapshot))
    assert file.startswith('tests/') and file.endswith('.test.ts'), file
    normalized = {'name': file, 'status': suite['status'], 'message': suite.get('message', ''), 'assertionResults': []}
    for test in suite['assertionResults']:
        identity = (file, test['fullName'])
        assert identity not in identities, ('Duplicate identity', identity)
        identities.add(identity)
        statuses[test['status']] += 1
        normalized['assertionResults'].append({k: test[k] for k in ('fullName', 'title', 'status', 'failureMessages', 'duration') if k in test})
    tests.append(normalized)
assert len(identities) == raw['numTotalTests'], 'Reporter total differs from assertion identities'
assert statuses['passed'] == raw['numPassedTests'] and statuses['failed'] == raw['numFailedTests']
expected_failure_declarations = [p for p in source['filesSha256'] if p.startswith('tests/') and p.endswith('.ts') and re.search(r'\b(?:it|test)\.fails\s*\(', (snapshot / p).read_text())]
assert not expected_failure_declarations, 'Expected-failure declaration needs explicit accounting'
result = {
    'version': 1, 'id': args.id, 'bundleSha256': bundle['sha256'],
    'vitestJson': './' + Path(args.output).name,
    'scope': 'One unfiltered application execution on an immutable build and source snapshot; focused and historical counts are not added.',
    'counts': {'total': len(identities), 'pass': statuses['passed'], 'fail': statuses['failed'], 'skip': statuses['skipped'], 'todo': statuses['todo'], 'xfail': 0, 'xpass': 0, 'deselected': 0, 'errors': unhandled_count, 'testFiles': len(tests)},
    'testResults': tests, 'rawVitestJsonSha256': sha(args.vitest),
    'sourceAndTestFilesSha256': source['filesSha256'],
    'verification': {
        'command': args.command, 'processExitCode': args.exit_code, 'rawReporterSuccess': raw['success'],
        'testRunConfig': {'file': 'vitest.full.config.mts', 'sha256': sha(snapshot/'vitest.full.config.mts'), 'source': (snapshot/'vitest.full.config.mts').read_text()} if (snapshot/'vitest.full.config.mts').exists() else None,
        'rawLogSha256': sha(args.log), 'sourceTestConfigFilesStable': len(source['filesSha256']),
        'completeBuildSourceFilesMatched': sum(runtime(p) for p in source['filesSha256']),
        'frozenModuleFilesStable': len(bundle['files']), 'frozenModuleFilesSha256': bundle['files'],
        'expectedFailureDeclarations': expected_failure_declarations,
        'deselectionBasis': 'Unfiltered run command without test-name, file, tag or shard selectors; see captured command.',
        'rawSuiteCounts': {k: v for k, v in raw.items() if k.startswith('num')},
        'collectionErrors': [r for r in tests if r['status'] == 'failed' and not r['assertionResults']],
    },
}
Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result['counts']))
